prompt:
Slow handheld push-in toward him across 8 seconds, from medium to medium close-up. He raps quietly, small movements now: his head gives slow, small nods on the beat, his eyes stay down on the tarmac, then his head lifts once toward the left edge of frame and settles back; it never drops lower than at the start, so the red triangle stays in view the whole time. His free hand opens and closes at his side. The flute swings slightly from his fingers and one drop of champagne falls into a puddle. His weight shifts from one foot to the other. The fabric over his mouth stays closed. Rain keeps falling around him, puddles rippling. No speech: sound is rain and a far-off fire crackle.
Thanks.
